fullPassage: We think we're being logical, objective, and rational — and therefore accurate in our analysis, judgment, and decisions. So we think that if other people are logical, objective, and rational, they will agree with us and see what we see. But the opposite is the case. Every human brain is different. Everyone's life experience is different. Everyone's desires and knowledge are different. You might think you're being realistic — that is, that your ideas match reality, but that's impossible. It's only your interpretation of reality, which will always be different from someone else's. When two nations play each other in the World Cup, the fans of each country criticize the referees for missing all the infractions that the other team commits. Without fail, each fan base believes that the referees are biased against their team.

questions.passage: We think we're being (A)[logical / illogical], objective, and rational — and therefore accurate in our analysis, judgment, and decisions. So we think that if other people are logical, objective, and rational, they will agree with us and see what we see. But the opposite is the case. Every human brain is different. Everyone's life experience is different. Everyone's desires and knowledge are different. You might think you're being (B)[realistic / unrealistic] — that is, that your ideas match reality, but that's impossible. It's only your interpretation of reality, which will always be (C)[different / identical] from someone else's.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 우리는 논리적(logical)이고 객관적이라고 생각하며, 현실적(realistic)이라고 생각하지만 해석은 항상 다르다(different).
det.analysis:
✅ ① logical — realistic — different: 원문 일치
❌ ② illogical: logical 반의어
❌ ③ unrealistic: realistic 반의어
❌ ④ identical: different 반의어

questions.passage: We think we're being logical, objective, and rational — and therefore (A)[accurate / inaccurate] in our analysis, judgment, and decisions. Every human brain is different. Everyone's life experience is different. It's only your (B)[interpretation / distortion] of reality, which will always be different from someone else's. When two nations play each other in the World Cup, the fans of each country (C)[criticize / praise] the referees for missing all the infractions that the other team commits.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 정확한(accurate) 분석, 현실에 대한 해석(interpretation), 심판을 비판(criticize)한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② accurate — interpretation — criticize: 원문 일치
❌ ① inaccurate: accurate 반의어
❌ ③ distortion(왜곡): interpretation과 다름
❌ ④ praise(칭찬): criticize 반의어

questions.passage: You might think you're being realistic — that is, that your ideas match reality, but that's (A)[impossible / possible]. It's only your interpretation of reality, which will always be different from someone else's. When two nations play each other in the World Cup, the fans of each country criticize the referees for missing all the (B)[infractions / achievements] that the other team commits. Without fail, each fan base believes that the referees are (C)[biased / fair] against their team.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 현실과 일치하는 것은 불가능(impossible)하며, 상대팀의 반칙(infractions)을 놓쳤다고 생각하고, 심판이 편향적(biased)이라 믿는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ impossible — infractions — biased: 원문 일치
❌ ① possible: impossible 반의어
❌ ② achievements(업적): infractions 반의어
❌ ④ fair(공정한): biased 반의어

questions.passage: We think we're being logical, objective, and rational — and therefore accurate in our analysis, judgment, and decisions. So we think that if other people are logical, objective, and rational, they will ①<u>agree</u> with us and see what we see. But the ②<u>opposite</u> is the case. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ identical(동일한)은 문맥상 different(다른)이어야 한다. 개인의 현실 해석은 항상 다르다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ identical: 원문 different → 해석은 항상 '다르다'
✅ ① agree: 원문 일치
✅ ② opposite: 원문 일치
✅ ③ different: 원문 일치

When two nations play each other in the World Cup, the fans of each country ③<u>criticize</u> the referees for missing all the infractions that the other team commits. Without fail, each fan base believes that the referees are ④<u>impartial</u> against their team.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ impartial(공정한)은 문맥상 biased(편향된)이어야 한다. 팬들은 심판이 자기 팀에 불리하게 편향되어 있다고 믿는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ impartial: 원문 biased → 팬들은 심판이 편향적이라 생각
✅ ① realistic: 원문 일치
✅ ② interpretation: 원문 일치
✅ ③ criticize: 원문 일치
